steps: Ingest camera originals; establish source interpretation and sequence settings
Patch incoming video/audio streams separately from track targeting
Three/four-point insert or overwrite
Refine linked picture/sound with ripple, roll, slip, slide and modal trim
Nest/relink/conform; send audio post and composition interchange
Grade with declared measurement space; deliver source-range-specific outputs
workflows.semantic_contract: Slip keeps timeline start and duration fixed while moving both source bounds equally; roll preserves sequence duration; source patching is distinct from target navigation.
workflows.counterexample: Three linked V/A clips, one sync-locked audio track and one unlocked track; negative slip at source zero, ripple across a locked neighbour, different track targeting and patching. Compare affected clip IDs, exact source/timeline bounds and undo, not only a screenshot.

steps: Interpret footage and alpha; establish composition timebase and color working space
Compose nested layers, parenting, track mattes, adjustment layers and expressions
Retiming via Time Remap; differentiate frame mix and pixel motion
Inspect source-time versus composition-time at keyframes
Queue one composition with separate render settings and multiple output modules
Deliver mezzanine, proxy and image sequence; preserve editable source separately
workflows.semantic_contract: Freeze Frame replaces existing Time Remap keyframes with a Hold keyframe; current_settings is a live binding, not an explicit copied value. Baked visual interchange does not preserve editable expressions, masks or parenting.
workflows.counterexample: Nested precomp with animated mask, expression, 3D parent, guide layer and a two-frame freeze; export with no prerender and missing prerender asset; queue RGB straight-alpha and premultiplied outputs from one composition. Assert semantic-loss manifest and alpha/color interpretation.

steps: Open Waveform for per-file destructive repair or Multitrack for reversible clip arrangement
Route mono/stereo/5.1 tracks through buses and sends
Set pan law and monitor track versus mix levels
Apply processing and automation; keep original media identity
Export stems/mix with explicit channel order, sample rate and loudness profile
Reimport into picture timeline and verify sync and handles
workflows.semantic_contract: Waveform edits and nondestructive multitrack operations must remain distinct; equal-power versus logarithmic panning and track versus mix meters are different controls. Channel-count enums alone do not prove channel-order routing.
workflows.counterexample: Mono narration centered into stereo, 5.1 impulse on each labeled channel, pre/post-fader send, mute/solo combination, automation crossing block boundary, 44.1-kHz source into 48-kHz session; compare independent rendered samples and source bytes.

steps: Author source range and immutable preset identity
Attach multiple output instances to one source
Queue or watch-folder ingestion
Start queue; observe per-output state
Recover an interrupted output without overwriting completed siblings
Verify final codec, metadata, color, audio and duration independently
workflows.semantic_contract: Watch-folder discovery is not completion; one source can have multiple output instances and queued items are processed when the queue starts. UXP Watch Folder reference is public beta, since 27.0; do not assume installed 2026 supports it.
workflows.counterexample: Source arrives in chunks, two presets produce same basename, one output fails halfway, queue paused then restarted, 100 source jobs admitted by simultaneous agents. Prove bounded bytes and jobs, deterministic collision refusal and per-output recovery.

steps: Inspect page objects, fonts, color spaces, output intent, overprint and document structure
Mark redactions separately from applying them
Apply content removal and explicitly sanitize hidden information
Save a rewritten artifact and independently reopen it
Inspect separations/prepress and accessibility semantics separately
Validate the declared standard with an independent conformance engine
workflows.semantic_contract: Opaque rectangles are not redaction; redaction application and hidden-information sanitization are separate operations. PDF/A object-graph checks do not establish PDF/X or PDF/UA conformance.
workflows.counterexample: Shared form XObject on two pages, ActualText/Alt containing removed text, hidden OCG, attachment, old incremental revision, partially intersecting image, transparency and spot overprint. Search decoded reachable and obsolete objects after rewritten save; compare independent rendering and structure extraction.

steps: Define local site root and remote/testing target distinctly
Choose document-relative versus site-root-relative links
Edit code, split and live views with focus-sensitive controls
Move asset and update all referring documents
Preview through testing server for root-relative links
Review sync plan with dependent assets and emit per-file publishing outcomes
workflows.semantic_contract: Site-relative link base requires site/server context; remote and testing roles differ. Existing server-language constructs must retain bytes even where generation is intentionally out of scope.
workflows.counterexample: Nested CSS URL and HTML srcset refer to renamed asset, mixed Unicode filenames, root-relative link under non-root deployment prefix, locked template region, PHP text not interpreted as HTML, partial SFTP publish. Compare complete canonical document set and per-file outcomes.

control_semantics.evidence: FilmCraft timeline_trim_ui.rs executes pointer-down/move/release through FilmcraftApp test harness; this is test source, not a passing runtime result.

control_semantics.requirement: Distinguish selected, queued and all queue items; each queued item can own several output modules.
control_semantics.evidence: Installed Change Render Locations.jsx loops only RQItemStatus.QUEUED and then every numOutputModules, preserving oldLocation.name. Script opens Folder.selectDialog and alerts; inspect only, never execute in quiet research.

control_semantics.requirement: Disabled state depends on active document, global Hide All Visual Aids, focus and split view; it is not a global boolean.
control_semantics.evidence: Installed CSS_Layout_Tools.js canAcceptCommand checks dw.getActiveWindow(), getHideAllVisualAids(), dw.getFocus(), and dom.getView() == split.

control_semantics.requirement: Expose pan law, track-format/channel labels, per-track and mix meters separately; assistive labels and keyboard scrubbing must identify unit and target.
control_semantics.evidence: Adobe basic multitrack manual describes equal-power and logarithmic panning, mono/stereo/5.1 tracks; native accessibility behavior NOT_INSPECTED.

craft_findings.finding: TimelineFormat enum contains Fcp7Xml/Fcpxml/Otio/Edl/Aaf/Omf; default export format is Fcp7Xml. export() forwards opts.format.fc() to FilmCraft interchange writer. This inspected path cannot substantiate native .prproj writing.
craft_findings.impact: Calling interchange an editable native project export would hide lost editing semantics.
craft_findings.mitigation: Use explicit format provenance and object-level loss map; retain native-format work as unresolved adapter requirement.

craft_findings.finding: Plan::Render without supplied prerender media warns that layer was left out; PrerenderMode::None warns on unsupported features while native/nested processing continues.
craft_findings.impact: Export success with warnings can yield missing layers or baked content.
craft_findings.mitigation: Typed loss diagnostics must identify omitted/baked objects and missing assets, with explicit approval policy; compare pixels plus editable graph after independent reimport.

craft_findings.finding: preflight Level enum exposes A2b and A3b; verify/convert operate on these levels. This API does not provide PDF/X/UA validation.
craft_findings.impact: Standards panel or PDF/A label cannot prove print-ready spot/overprint output or accessible structure.
craft_findings.mitigation: Separate archive, prepress and accessibility validators and standards evidence; independently validate each declared standard.

craft_findings.finding: apply() performs Mode::Verify and returns Residue if content remains, then require_full_save(); sanitize removal also requires full save. Real code paths exist, but verifier shares implementation with mutator.
craft_findings.impact: Shared parser/coverage gaps can hide residue from both application and internal verification.
craft_findings.mitigation: Independent decoded-object/text/resource extraction and full saved-byte reopen, including prior revisions; do not claim proof from internal check alone.

craft_findings.finding: ChannelFormat enumerates mono/stereo/surround/Atmos/ambisonic channel widths in mixer model. Enum and channels() are source structure, not evidence of Audition session import or exact routing output.
craft_findings.impact: Counting supported channel variants overstates professional audio-post readiness.
craft_findings.mitigation: Channel-labeled impulse, pan-law and stem delivery oracles; separately inspect session-format reader/writer and source destructiveness.

craft_findings.finding: Interchange Format enum lists six timeline formats and inspected UI trim test uses demo-project pointer gestures. These are reusable implementation/proof patterns, not native Premiere interoperability or real GUI proof.
craft_findings.impact: Self-authored demo fixture can miss real media handles, mixed rates, locked tracks and assistive input.
craft_findings.mitigation: Original-app-produced fixtures with independently observed graph/render truth; canonical media relink and edit identity assertions.

craft_findings.finding: write_incremental checks full_save_required and delegates to write_full. write_full traverses refs from Root/Info/Encrypt into a newly numbered reachable-object set; this supports old-revision removal design, not independent runtime security proof.
craft_findings.impact: Do not diagnose an incremental-revision leak merely from ordinary incremental-save support; source already has a full-save safeguard.
craft_findings.mitigation: Independent post-save byte/object/text oracle must prove retained original/preservation blob never enters sanitized export.
